text: Automatically checkpoints completed steps so a workflow resumes after a crash instead of restarting
quote: Code automatically stores completed steps and resumes from where it left off when recovering from failures.

text: Lets services maintain durable state shared across functions with strong consistency
quote: Maintain state beyond workflow executions and share it between functions with strong consistency guarantees.

text: Supports sync/async service calls with guaranteed, exactly-once execution
quote: Call services sync or async with guaranteed execution and exactly-once semantics.

text: Per-scope concurrency limits shape traffic and protect downstream services
quote: Shape traffic with concurrency limits per scope to control cost, protect downstream services, and keep scheduling fair.

text: Durable timers let workflows sleep, schedule, and wait for external events
quote: Sleep, schedule, and wait for external events with durable timers.

text: Coordinates long-running processes including human approvals and webhook signals
quote: Coordinate long-running processes, human approvals, listen to webhooks and other signals.

text: Services can run anywhere: containers, serverless functions, VMs, or Kubernetes
quote: Deploy anywhere: Services run in your infrastructure as containers, serverless functions, VMs, or Kubernetes pods

text: Functions can be invoked over plain HTTP requests to the Restate Server
quote: To call a function over HTTP, send a request to the Restate Server, specifying the service and the function you want to invoke.

text: Typed clients let external apps invoke Restate handlers
quote: Use typed clients from external applications to invoke Restate handlers

text: CLI and Introspection SQL API expose invocation and state information
quote: Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.

text: Native request identity lets SDKs cryptographically verify requests came from a specific Restate instance
quote: Restate has a native request identity feature which can be used in the SDK to cryptographically verify that requests have come from a particular Restate instance.

text: Ships as a single binary implementing all features to run single- or multi-node clusters
quote: Restate is distributed as a single binary that implements all features required to run a single- or multi-node cluster

text: Can run as Restate Cloud, BYOC managed region, or fully self-operated
quote: You can use Restate Cloud, run a managed Restate region in your cloud account with Restate BYOC, or operate Restate yourself.

text: Automatically retries transient errors and persists LLM/tool call progress for recovery after failures
quote: Automatically retry transient errors like rate limits and network failures. Persist steps (LLM calls, tools) and recover previous progress after failures.

text: A few lines of code turn an agent into a durable, crash-resistant agent
quote: A few lines turn your agent into a durable agent.

text: AI agents durably persist every LLM call, tool execution, and routing decision to survive crashes
quote: Build AI agents that survive crashes and recover automatically. Every LLM call, tool execution, and routing decision is durably persisted.

text: ctx.run wraps non-deterministic operations and persists their results in the execution log
quote: Use `ctx.run` to safely wrap any non-deterministic operation, like HTTP calls or database responses, and have Restate store its result in the execution log.

text: ctx.run retry behavior is customizable
quote: You can customize how `ctx.run` retries via:

text: Provides durable coordination primitives for inter-invocation communication, agent steering, and human approvals
quote: Restate provides three durable coordination primitives for this: ... Communication between ongoing invocations, agent steering, and human approvals

text: Suspends serverless handlers while sleeping to free up billable compute resources
quote: If your handler runs on function-as-a-service platforms like AWS Lambda, Restate suspends the handler while it is sleeping, to free up resources.

text: Terminal errors end an invocation immediately and propagate the error to the caller instead of retrying
quote: For failures for which you do not want retries, but instead want the invocation to end and the error message to be propagated back to the caller, you can throw a **terminal error**.

text: Testcontainers-based utility runs a real Restate Server in Docker to test handlers
quote: This uses [Testcontainers](https://testcontainers.com/) to run a Restate Server in a Docker container and let you test your Restate handlers.

text: Ensures retries of an invocation always hit the same service version/endpoint for safe deploys
quote: Restate then makes sure that requests start and end on the same version, by sending any retry attempts always to the same endpoint.

text: Official plugin teaches coding agents Restate SDK APIs, patterns, and pitfalls for building apps
quote: The Restate plugin teaches your coding agent how to build Restate apps: Durable Execution, service types, SDK APIs, common pitfalls, and AI agent integration patterns

text: Provides distributed durable primitives (workflows, state, timers) usable across many use cases
quote: Restate provides a distributed durable version of your everyday building blocks, letting you build a wide range of use cases

text: Official SDKs available for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go, and Rust
quote: Restate supports the following SDKs: * [Typescript] * [Java and Kotlin] * [Python] * [Go] * [Rust]
